Strategy for Grid Day 3:
- Block 2 (Morning): Charge 10 MWh to build storage for the Peak block
- Block 3 (Peak): Hold (no energy to sell yet)
- Block 4 (Evening): Discharge 10 MWh at $60/MWh

This follows the team's objective to maximize combined profit. By charging in Block 2, we set up storage for the high-peak price in Block 3. Although we initially face a realized price of $30/MWh in Block 2 (due to net charging), the subsequent discharge in Block 4 at $80/MWh (due to net discharging) yields a significant profit. Overall, this cycle improves our total from -1000 credits to -500 credits.
